with academic excellence and holistic development Pub Bongsor College, Pacharia was established in 1994 by the conscious and enthusiastic local social workers of seventeen village under Pub Bongsor Mouza in the district of Kamrup, Assam. The college is situated on the north bank of the mighty Brahmaputra, and is about fifteen kms away from Gauhati University, and also the nearest Gauhati University affiliated college from the district head quarte.. View All → Quality Education Experienced faculty & modern pedagogy Research Focus State-of-the-art research facilities Student Support Comprehensive student services Established in 1994 Principal's Desk Leadership, Vision & Academic Excellence Dr. Dadul Borah Principal "Education is the most powerful weapon which you can use to change the world." Message from the Principal A warm welcome from the Principal's Office Welcome and Warm Greetings from Pub Bongsor College. Our college is situated at Pacharia village in the Sualkuchi Block of Kamrup District of Assam. It is just 11 KM towards west from District Head quarter Amingaon. Established in the year 1994, the college has been imparting undergraduate level of education in Arts streams comprising seven (7) Academic Departments. The Academic Departments are affiliated to Gauhati University (GU). In addition to the academic departments, the college offers add on / skill e..
